options.name: attributes
options.description: List of Name/Value pairs in JSON object format.

options.name: element_username
options.description: Unique username for this account. (May be 1 to 64 characters in length).

options.name: from_name
options.description: ID or Name of the account to rename. Required to create an account called 'element_username' by renaming 'from_name'.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: initiator_secret
options.description: CHAP secret to use for the initiator. Should be 12-16 characters long and impenetrable. The CHAP initiator secrets must be unique and cannot be the same as the target CHAP secret. If not specified, a random secret is created.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified account should exist or not.

options.name: target_secret
options.description: CHAP secret to use for the target (mutual CHAP authentication). Should be 12-16 characters long and impenetrable. The CHAP target secrets must be unique and cannot be the same as the initiator CHAP secret. If not specified, a random secret is created.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).
